translationRepairs: Since Kangxi 53 (1714), when the native official Lu Dingqian broke the law, imperial commissioners and the provincial governors jointly tried Bi Jie; Lu emerged only after a regular official was sent in as hostage—and from then on he grew ever bolder.

Since Kangxi 53 (1714), when the native official Lu Dingqian broke the law, imperial commissioners and the provincial governors held a joint trial at Bijie; Lu emerged only after a regular official was sent in as hostage—and from then on he grew ever bolder.
The grammar places 畢節 after 會審 as the location of the joint trial. Bijie is a place, not the person being tried; the offender named in the sentence is Lu Dingqian.
